budget_items.what_was_recorded: Fireworks for the proposed carnival would cost $12,000 with barges on Lake Whalom and $6,000 without barges.
budget_items.quote: they would cost $12,000 with barges on lake whalom, and $6,000 without the barges.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The committee noted the cost of shuttle buses would need to be factored in; no figure was given.
budget_items.quote: parking could be made available at local businesses and shuttle buses used.

budget_items.topic: Vendor revenue share and firework payment
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Vendors would give the committee 20% of gross event profits and pay 50% of fireworks costs if a multi-day event were held.
budget_items.quote: there are vendors who would give us 20% of gross event proﬁts, and pay 50% of ﬁreworks if we held a multi-day event.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A prior Westminster sponsorship idea was looked into but did not appear to make money; no figure was given.
budget_items.quote: dawn had looked into what westminster did for their dogs for the westminster cracker sponsorship, but it didn't seem that they made money on it
